thesis: This episode uses the Acquirer's Multiple to evaluate value, contrasting cheap but superseded companies like Kodak with robust ones like META that have turned around. It also profiles several well-known value managers who established their reputations before 2010, including Dan Loeb, Bill Ackman, Monish Puri, Guy Spier, and David Ironside.
